summary:
BUFFALO, N.Y., Jan. 18, 2023 /PRNewswire/ -- M&T Bank Corporation (NYSE: MTB) ("M&T") announced today the election of Carlton J. Charles, Senior Vice President, Treasury and Risk Management at Hearst, to its Board of Directors, effective January 18, 2023.  Upon his election, Mr. Charles was appointed as a member of the Nomination and Governance Committee of M&T's Board.  Mr. Charles was also elected to the Board of Directors of M&T Bank, M&T's principal banking subsidiary.
